description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for a project initialization tool. It handles parsing command-line arguments, creating project configurations, constructing template information, and outputting JSON-formatted results. The file interacts with external modules for templates, project configuration, and project initialization, and includes commands for both initializing projects and retrieving run commands for specific project types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig instance from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig for retrieving template info, mainly used for the get-run-command feature.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints JSON output indicating success/failure and related messages, including template configuration details.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles retrieving the run command for a given project type via command-line arguments, creating a minimal project config and extracting template info.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments to either initialize a project or retrieve a run command, coordinating the overall flow.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
